solver_tolerance.rationale: The V_scale=0.01 floor prevents false fixed-point lock-in observed with Vmax-scale; dimensionally meaningful across operating regimes.

flow_feasibility_global.implementation: Newton system has global flow row: F[N] = sum_i (V_new - V_old)/dt - Q_requested. Jacobian row J[N][i] = 1/dt couples all compartments to the boundary.
flow_feasibility_global.classification: INFEASIBLE_BOUNDARY returned when |Q_requested * dt| > Σ capacity remaining
